motion.name: reduced-motion

narrative.overview:
The career is typeset like a company's annual report: a cover, a dark key-figures spread, then chapters set as ruled tables on a strict 12-column grid. Authority comes from alignment, hairline rules and real numbers, never from decoration. The page is bright white stock with graphite ink, one gold, and one flat deep-space spread that ties the site to the owner's GitHub banner.

Density is editorial rather than dashboard: generous vertical chapters (up to 8.5rem apart), tight internal rhythm, and every row closed by a rule instead of enclosed in a box. Type does the hierarchy: Geist Light at display scale, Medium for row titles, Regular for reading text. Motion is almost absent; the one signature is that the measured figures settle and the one chart draws, once.

The world refuses the dev-portfolio default: no dark gradient hero, no cards, no skill bars, no monospace, no pill buttons.
keyCharacteristics: White stock, graphite ink, a single gold; one flat dark spread per page at most.
12-column grid with rules in place of containers.
Geist only, Light at display scale, tabular numerals on every figure and date.
Squared interface chrome; rounding only on objects that are round in reality.
Motion reserved for measured data; everything else is still except hover colour.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only hue. It marks structure and measurement; it never fills a surface.

rules.name: The Gold Carries Text Only as Ledger Gold Rule
rules.body: On white, any gold glyph that must be read uses `gold-ink`; `gold` is reserved for rules, bars and underlines. On `space`, `gold` itself may be read.

rules.name: The Single Spread Rule
rules.body: Deep Space appears as one full-bleed band holding real key figures. It is not a theme toggle, not a hero, and never a gradient.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every figure, date and number set in `<strong>` uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Light-at-Scale Rule
rules.body: Anything at headline size or larger is Geist 300 with negative tracking; weight 500 is for row titles and the name, never for display.

rules.name: The No-Mono Rule
rules.body: No monospace anywhere. Geist Mono was tried and dropped because it read as dev costume.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Box Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with horizontal rules on the grid, never with enclosing borders, backgrounds or cards.

rules.name: The Flat Stock Rule
rules.body: If a surface looks lifted off the page, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Square Chrome Rule
rules.body: Actions are squared, never pills. Corner radius belongs to depicted devices and app marks, not to interface elements.

dos: **Do** lay every block on the 12-column grid and close rows with a rule.
**Do** set display and headline sizes in Geist 300 with negative tracking, and every number in tabular figures.
**Do** use `gold` for rules, bars and marks, and `gold-ink` whenever gold must be read on white.
**Do** keep employer logos single-ink (greyscale on white, inverted white on the spread); product app icons keep their own colours because they are the product's mark.
**Do** show a figure only where a real measurement exists, and pair it with its unit or period.
**Do** make every animation static under `prefers-reduced-motion` and without JavaScript.
donts: **Don't** use cards, boxed containers, or background fills to group content.
**Don't** add drop shadows or elevation; the only shadow is the 1px app-icon keyline.
**Don't** round interface elements or use pill buttons; radius is for app icons and device frames.
**Don't** use colour gradients. The flat Deep Space spread stays flat (solid-colour gradients used as rule lines are fine).
**Don't** animate anything except measured data entering view and hover colour.
